claims.claim: Izutech solar energy specialize in all solar equipment
claims.evidence: The witness report confirms the presence of panels but cannot verify the seller's business expertise or inventory of other equipment.
Photo 0 shows two solar panels in front and a stack of several more behind them.

risks.proof: A clear photo of the manufacturer's specification label on the back of the panels.
risks.if_unproven: as the lowest possible wattage for panels of this physical dimension.

risks.proof: A video showing a multimeter reading of the Open Circuit Voltage (Voc) and Short Circuit Current (Isc) in direct sunlight.

risks.risk: Damaged junction boxes or missing connectors
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the rear of the panels showing the junction boxes and the state of the MC4 cables.
risks.if_unproven: as requiring cable and box replacement.

risks.proof: A photo showing all panels spread out individually.
risks.if_unproven: as only the two clearly visible panels.

proof_requests: Photos of the specification labels on the back of the panels.
Photos of the junction boxes and wiring on the back.
A photo of all panels laid out to confirm the total count.
A short video showing a multimeter test of the panels' output in sunlight.
response.reason: The power rating (Watts) is the primary driver of price and is currently unknown. Without the specification label or a multimeter test, it is impossible to distinguish between high-capacity panels and low-value or defective units.
